label: agent loop • todo created up front and updated before complete
query: Three config files in this folder each have debug=true. Change debug to false in all three, then verify by reading them back. Track your progress with a todo list as you work.
notes: Pins todo discipline on a genuinely multi-step task: the model must create the checklist, update it during work, and leave its final parseable checklist fully checked before the ordinary final response. This is a model-quality assertion only; production still treats Todo as advisory so an incomplete checklist can never reopen a final answer and cause a repetition loop.
